_comment: Three to five powder a block. The block itself never drops - it is a seam, not a building
material, and handing it back would let a player carry the deep dark around as a block.
requiresCorrectToolForDrops on the block plus #minecraft:needs_diamond_tool is what makes this
yield nothing to a copper or iron sledgehammer. There is no tool condition in this table
because there does not need to be one: the tier gate is a property of the block.
